newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM mulls price hike as oil prices soar.
newsitem.headline: KLM mulls price hike as oil prices soar.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch airlines said on Tuesday it was considering raising prices after a month of high oil prices, but was reluctant to do so unilaterally.
"There is a possibility that there will be a surcharge on our tariffs, but, if we did that, it would be a good idea that the industry would follow us," said a KLM spokesman.
Jet kerosene prices have risen 20 percent since Iraqi troops entered Kurdish-controlled northern Iraq at the very end of August.
The invasion halted a $2 billion Iraqi/United Nations oil-for-food deal and led to U.S. missile attacks on Iraq.
Prices, at their highest level since Iraqi troops invaded Kuwait in 1990, are also 48 percent higher than a mid-summer low.
"We spend a good deal on kerosene and the costs have dramatically increased," the KLM spokesman said.
